name: Earlobe support patches

lead: Earlobe support patches are thin clear stickers worn behind the lobe. The earring post goes through them.
They spread an earring's weight so a stretched or thin piercing droops less, which keeps the ear looking neat.

paras: The disc adds a wider, firmer base behind the lobe so the post sits higher and straighter in the hole.
They support but do not repair tissue. Badly torn lobes are treated surgically, and adhesives can irritate sensitive skin.

chain: Weight is spread across the lobe
Earring hangs straight without dragging the hole
angle.text: Patches let a stretched or drooping piercing hold an earring upright and comfortable, keeping the ear looking neat while wearing heavier jewellery.

lead: Earlobe support patches are small clear adhesive discs that stick to the back of the earlobe, with the earring post pushed through them. They spread the weight of an earring over a wider area so heavy or dangling earrings pull less on a stretched or thin piercing, helping the lobe look tidy and letting people wear the earrings they like.

The earlobe is made of connective and fatty tissue with no cartilage, which makes it soft and prone to stretching or tearing under heavy jewellery [1]. Common brands include Lobe Wonder, Lobe Miracle and Earlift. They support the lobe but do not repair tissue.
infobox: Hours to a few days per patch

paras: Patches are clear, self-adhesive and thin, often with a mesh or criss-cross backing. The post passes through the disc and the earring back then secures it. Reviewers describe wearing them through events lasting many hours, doubling them for heavy earrings, and finding the first push of the post through the patch slightly fiddly.

Piercing is very common, and injury from heavy earrings is common too; reported problems include inflammation, keloids, tearing and splitting of the lobe [1]. A repair procedure for torn earlobes is described in the clinical literature, and some severely split lobes are handled surgically [1].
The patches appeal to people who want a statement earring without a visibly dropped lobe. Users also pair them with lighter earrings or flat-back posts.
